options.per_residue_average: sqrt(sum_i m_i MSF_i / sum_i m_i) over the residue's selected atoms, as gmx rmsf -res

frames.said: 71 of 200 frames were analysed, from frame 129, where the RMSD equilibrates. The RMSD of these atoms from the first frame equilibrates after 129 frames, and none of those are included.
